verdict.rationale: uv is a locally installed command-line package and project manager (installed via standalone installer, curl, or pip on macOS/Linux/Windows), not a hosted service, so there is no hosted core product to self-host. Self-hosting is the wrong axis for this kind of product, and the evidence shows no server or hosted component that would make it apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
